key_developments: SpaceX was added to the Nasdaq 100 on July 9, 2026, with a market cap of roughly $2 trillion, but its share price fell 26.5% from $225.64 to $148.3 on the first day of trading.
The IPO was priced at $135 per share, and analysts project a potential dip to $132 by next June.
SpaceX reported a Q1 2026 loss of $4.27 billion from Starlink revenue.
Despite the SpaceX listing, the Nasdaq 100 closed up 0.33% at 29,825.11 and the S&P 500 up 0.42% at 7,575.39 on July 10, 2026, reflecting broader market gains.
